scope: Native dependency imports only; no ViT forward, backward, optimization, or checkpoint downloads were executed by these probes.

reproduction.command: .venv/bin/python -c 'import timm, kornia; from transformers import CLIPTextModel'
reproduction.native_debugger: gdb --batch -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'set print thread-events off' -ex run -ex 'bt 24' --args .venv/bin/python -c 'import timm, kornia; from transformers import CLIPTextModel'

fix.provenance: The installed libarrow.so.2500 contains the JE_ARROW_MALLOC_CONF string. gdb identified its allocator background thread as the faulting thread; the namespaced setting removes that thread's initialization failure.
fix.existing_allocator_settings: Unrelated options are preserved. An explicitly configured background_thread option is respected; an explicit true value can reproduce the platform fault.
dependency_changes: Added easydict==1.13 to optional extra for the official EASE implementation. Existing package versions remain locked.

verification.native_help_note: Help discovery uses the existing cached legacy CLIP weights; no EASE training or neural forward was run.
verification.focused_tests: uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/test_cl_runtime.py tests/test_ease_backbone.py tests/test_ease.py -q --tb=short
verification.validation_bootstrap: None: no pyarrow-first bootstrap or legacy CLIP mock was used for the final native checks.
